name: Ethoxylated tallow propylene diamine
description: Ethoxylated tallow propylene diamine (CAS 61790-85-0 ) is a fatty diamine ethoxylate derived from tallow-based alkyl chains. It functions as a cationic or nonionic surfactant depending on the pH and specific formulation conditions of the application. This versatile chemical delivers superior emulsification, surface wetting, and degreasing performance. It is widely utilized across industrial cleaning, textile processing, and various agricultural formulations to enhance product stability and effectiveness. In textile and leather processing, it acts as a softening and wetting agent. It improves fiber lubrication and dye bath penetration during finishing operations, ensuring a high-quality result for the final textile or leather products. Agricultural formulations use it as an emulsifier and dispersant in herbicide and pesticide concentrates. This helps active ingredients spread uniformly on leaf surfaces, maximizing the efficacy of the treatment in various environmental conditions. Industrial and institutional cleaners incorporate it for degreasing hard surfaces. It is particularly effective where both wetting speed and soil suspension are critical to maintaining high cleaning efficiency in demanding commercial environments. In paper manufacturing, it supports surface modification treatments that improve sizing agent adhesion. This process enhances sheet uniformity and overall paper quality, making it a valuable additive for large-scale production facilities. Ethoxylated tallow propylene diamine is typically supplied as a liquid or paste. The viscosity and appearance vary by the degree of ethoxylation, allowing for customization based on the specific needs of the industrial formulator. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering, with ethoxylation levels ranging to suit specific HLB requirements.
